verdict.rationale: Stripe Treasury is a financial-account product accessed through the Stripe Dashboard and mobile app, so a built-in AI assistant is a fair axis, but nothing in the evidence documents an in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The official MCP server, llms.txt and CLI are developer and agent-integration building blocks for a different story, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
